name: ensembl
description: Ensembl (ensembl.org) genome browser: search thousands of genome assemblies, read genome metadata and stats, look up genes, transcripts, proteins, homologues, external references and variants (with predicted consequences), and fetch reference sequence through Ensembl's public JSON and GraphQL APIs.

commands.name: search-genomes
commands.summary: Search genome assemblies by name. Can list every assembly of one species by taxonomy id, and can sort (e.g. by contig N50) and paginate.

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text search: common name, scientific name or assembly name/accession

params.name: species_taxonomy_id
params.description: NCBI species taxonomy id. Restricts results to all assemblies of that species (e.g. 9606 = human, 10090 = mouse)

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by, e.g. contig_n50. Omit for relevance ranking

commands.name: export-genomes-csv
commands.summary: Download genome search results as CSV text, matching search-genomes for the same query.

params.name: species_taxonomy_id
params.description: NCBI species taxonomy id that restricts the export to one species' assemblies

commands.name: get-genome
commands.summary: Get metadata for one genome by its UUID: assembly, providers, annotation version/date, release and reference status.

commands.name: get-genome-stats
commands.summary: Get statistics for a genome: assembly (N50, length, GC%), coding, non-coding, pseudogene and variation counts.

commands.name: get-genome-example-objects
commands.summary: Get example gene, location and variant ids for a genome. These are handy starting points for gene and variant lookups.

commands.name: list-popular-species
commands.summary: List popular species with their taxonomy id and number of available genomes.

commands.name: list-genome-groups
commands.summary: List genome group categories, such as external projects like VGP and BGE, with genome counts.

commands.name: get-genome-counts
commands.summary: Get the total number of genomes in Ensembl and the count per taxonomic group (Animals, Archaea, …).

commands.name: list-releases
commands.summary: List Ensembl data releases (name, type integrated/partial, is_current).

commands.name: search-genes
commands.summary: Search genes by symbol, name or stable id within one genome. Returns stable ids, biotype and location.

params.name: query
params.description: Gene symbol, name or Ensembl stable id

params.name: genome_id
params.description: Genome UUID to search in (default: Human GRCh38.p14)

commands.name: search-variants
commands.summary: Search variants (e.g. by rsID) within one genome.

commands.name: get-gene-summary
commands.summary: Get a gene's versioned stable id, symbol, chromosome location, strand and biotype.

params.name: geneId
params.description: Ensembl gene stable id (unversioned ok), e.g. ENSG00000139618

bodyTemplate.query: query GeneSummary($genomeId: String!, $geneId: String!) { gene(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, stable_id: $geneId }) { stable_id unversioned_stable_id symbol slice { location { start end } strand { code } region { name } } metadata { biotype { label } } } }

commands.name: get-gene-overview
commands.summary: Get a gene's full name, alternative symbols (synonyms), HGNC accession and biotype.

bodyTemplate.query: query GeneOverview($genomeId: String!, $geneId: String!) { gene(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, stable_id: $geneId }) { alternative_symbols name stable_id symbol metadata { name { accession_id url } biotype { value } } } }

commands.name: get-gene-structure
commands.summary: Get a gene's transcripts with exon layout, CDS coordinates, protein product ids and canonical/MANE flags. This is what the feature explorer gene view draws.

bodyTemplate.query: query DefaultEntityViewerGene($genomeId: String!, $geneId: String!) { gene(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, stable_id: $geneId }) { stable_id symbol unversioned_stable_id version slice { location { start end length } strand { code } } transcripts_page(page: 1, per_page: 100) { transcripts { stable_id unversioned_stable_id slice { location { start end length } region { name } strand { code } } relative_location { start end } spliced_exons { relative_location { start end } exon { stable_id slice { location { length } } } } product_generating_contexts { product_type cds { relative_start relative_end } cdna { length } product { stable_id unversioned_stable_id length } } metadata { biotype { value } canonical { value label } mane { value label } } } } } }

commands.name: list-gene-transcripts
commands.summary: List all transcripts of a gene with biotype, length, canonical/MANE status and protein length. Also returns the gene location and region checksum.

bodyTemplate.query: query GeneForVariantTranscriptConsequences($genomeId: String!, $geneId: String!) { gene(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, stable_id: $geneId }) { stable_id unversioned_stable_id symbol slice { location { start end length } region { sequence { checksum } length } strand { code } } transcripts { stable_id unversioned_stable_id slice { location { length } } metadata { biotype { value } canonical { value label definition } mane { value label definition } } product_generating_contexts { product_type product { length } } } } }

commands.name: get-gene-external-references
commands.summary: Get cross-references (NCBI Gene, HGNC, OMIM, GeneCards, UniProt, RefSeq, …) for a gene and for each of its transcripts and proteins.

bodyTemplate.query: query GeneExternalReferences($geneId: String!, $genomeId: String!) { gene(by_id: { stable_id: $geneId, genome_id: $genomeId }) { stable_id symbol external_references { accession_id name description url source { id name } } transcripts_page(page: 1, per_page: 100) { transcripts { ...transcriptFields } } } } fragment transcriptFields on Transcript { stable_id slice { location { length } } external_references { accession_id name description url source { id name } } product_generating_contexts { product_type product { external_references { accession_id name description url source { id name } } } } metadata { canonical { value } mane { value } biotype { value } } }

commands.name: get-gene-homologies
commands.summary: List homologues/orthologues of a gene in other species, with homology type and percent identity/coverage.

params.name: geneId
params.description: Versioned Ensembl gene stable id, e.g. ENSG00000139618.19 (use stable_id from get-gene-summary)

bodyTemplate.query: query EntityViewerGeneHomologies($genomeId: String!, $geneId: String!) { homologies(genome_id: $genomeId, gene_stable_id: $geneId) { target_genome { genome_id common_name scientific_name assembly { accession_id name } } target_gene { stable_id symbol version unversioned_stable_id } query_genome { genome_id common_name scientific_name assembly { accession_id name } } query_gene { stable_id symbol version unversioned_stable_id } subtype { accession_id label value definition } stats { query_percent_id query_percent_coverage target_percent_id target_percent_coverage } } }

commands.name: get-transcript
commands.summary: Get one transcript's location, exons, CDS coordinates and protein product (id, length, sequence checksum).

params.name: transcriptId
params.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript stable id, e.g. ENST00000366667.6

bodyTemplate.query: query TranscriptForVariantTranscriptConsequences($genomeId: String!, $transcriptId: String!) { transcript(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, stable_id: $transcriptId }) { slice { location { start end length } } relative_location { start end length } spliced_exons { index relative_location { start end length } } product_generating_contexts { cds { relative_start relative_end nucleotide_length } product { stable_id length sequence { checksum } } } } }

commands.name: get-protein-domains
commands.summary: Get a protein's length and its domain/family matches (Pfam, PANTHER, InterPro, …) with positions.

params.name: productId
params.description: Versioned Ensembl protein stable id, e.g. ENSP00000369497.3

bodyTemplate.query: query ProteinDomains($genomeId: String!, $productId: String!) { product(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, stable_id: $productId }) { length family_matches { relative_location { start end } sequence_family { name description url source { name } } via { accession_id description url source { name } } } } }

commands.name: get-protein-structure-stats
commands.summary: Get PDBe summary counts for a UniProt accession: number of PDB structures, ligands, interaction partners and similar proteins.

commands.name: get-variant
commands.summary: Get variant details: location, alleles, allele type, dbSNP source, VEP prediction, citation count, phenotype assertions and population allele frequencies.

params.name: variantId
params.description: Variant id in the form {chromosome}:{position}:{rsID}, e.g. 1:230710048:rs699

bodyTemplate.query: query VariantDetails($genomeId: String!, $variantId: String!) { variant(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, variant_id: $variantId }) { name alternative_names { name url } slice { location { start end length } region { name } } allele_type { value } primary_source { url source { name release } } prediction_results { score result analysis_method { tool } } ensembl_website_display_data { count_citations } alleles { name allele_type { value } slice { location { start end } strand { code } } allele_sequence reference_sequence phenotype_assertions { feature } prediction_results { score result analysis_method { tool } } population_frequencies { is_minor_allele is_hpmaf allele_frequency } ensembl_website_display_data { count_transcript_consequences count_overlapped_genes count_regulatory_consequences count_variant_phenotypes count_gene_phenotypes representative_population_allele_frequency } } } }

commands.name: get-variant-consequences
commands.summary: Get the predicted molecular consequences of each allele of a variant on overlapping transcripts: consequence terms plus cDNA, CDS and protein positions with ref/alt.

bodyTemplate.query: query VariantPredictedMolecularConsequences($genomeId: String!, $variantId: String!) { variant(by_id: { genome_id: $genomeId, variant_id: $variantId }) { alleles { predicted_molecular_consequences { stable_id gene_stable_id gene_symbol cdna_location { ...RelativeLocationFields } cds_location { ...RelativeLocationFields } protein_location { ...RelativeLocationFields } consequences { value } } } } } fragment RelativeLocationFields on VariantRelativeLocation { start end length ref_sequence alt_sequence }

commands.name: get-region
commands.summary: Get a chromosome/region's length, topology and sequence checksum. Use the checksum with get-sequence.

bodyTemplate.query: query RegionChecksum($genomeId: String!, $regionName: String!) { region(by_name: { genome_id: $genomeId, name: $regionName }) { name length topology sequence { checksum } } }

commands.name: get-sequence
commands.summary: Fetch raw DNA or protein sequence (plain text) for a sequence checksum over a coordinate range, via refget. Uses 0-based start and exclusive end.

params.name: checksum
params.description: Sequence checksum: a region checksum from get-region, or a protein sequence checksum from get-transcript

params.name: start
params.description: 0-based start coordinate (inclusive). For a 1-based genomic position P, use P-1. Example: 230710027 for a variant flank

params.name: end
params.description: End coordinate (exclusive, 0-based). Equals the 1-based inclusive end. Length returned = end - start

notes: Most gene/variant commands take a genomeId (genome UUID). It defaults to Human GRCh38.p14 (59871324-7803-4234-856e-2a2bd96d7b3c). For other species, find the genome_id with search-genomes (use species_taxonomy_id to list all assemblies of one species).

Typical flow: search-genes → stable_id → get-gene-summary / get-gene-structure / list-gene-transcripts / get-gene-external-references / get-gene-homologies (homologies needs the versioned id, e.g. ENSG00000139618.19).

Variant ids use the form {chromosome}:{position}:{rsID} (e.g. 1:230710048:rs699). search-variants did not resolve rsIDs in the recording (0 hits), so build the id from a known position or from get-genome-example-objects.

Protein ids for get-protein-domains come from product.stable_id in get-gene-structure or get-transcript. UniProt accessions for get-protein-structure-stats (PDBe host) come from get-gene-external-references.
get-sequence returns plain text. Pass a region checksum (get-region) with genomic start/end, or a protein sequence checksum (get-transcript product.sequence.checksum) with protein coordinates.
export-genomes-csv was described by the explorer but not captured as a request; its parameters mirror search-genomes.
The GraphQL TranscriptSearch operation returned no hits for gene symbols or rsIDs, so it was left out; use search-genes instead.
The genome browser and BLAST are blocked by robots.txt and are not covered.

dropped.name: get-help-menu
dropped.summary: Get the Ensembl help/documentation menu tree (article titles and URLs).
dropped.verifyNote: Output is the help navigation menu tree, not site data, and no command fetches the article content.
